notes: Prism 2.6.2: a note you renamed keeps its name — including notes you renamed before the last update, which were still being overwritten when their notes were regenerated. Once Prism names a note, you can change it to whatever you like and it stays that way. Also in this update: calls that recorded but came back empty now write a real note, the meeting card shows up for the second of two back-to-back meetings, two calls inside one calendar block no longer overwrite each other, and the app no longer freezes when a call ends. Your audio is never stored. Free.
